rows.text: Reza Valizadeh, a former journalist for RFE/RL's Radio Farda, has been incarcerated in Tehran's Evin prison for two years. The dual US-Iranian citizen is serving a 10-year sentence for “collaborating with a hostile government,” a conviction his supporters and press-freedom groups reject.

rows.text: Shafaq News- Baghdad Ammunition stored at a site belonging to an armed faction exploded onThursday evening in Baghdad's southern Dora district, a security source toldShafaq News. The explosion, which was heard across Dora, involved munitions storedinside a portable cabin used by the faction, the source said. No casualties were reported. The source did not name the faction or give a cause for the explosion.
rows.title: Ammunition blast hits armed faction site in Baghdad
